_comment: LDTD raid rules. A raid's budget = base + perNight x (raids survived) + perLevel x (Hearth level - 1), capped at max, and +callEarlyBonus when called at the Hearth. Units are bought by weight from those allowed tonight (fromNight) until the budget runs out, each capped at maxShare of the budget. drain = Flame lost per second for each unit standing at the Hearth. Edit, then run /ldtd reload.
